title: Moui Bite Base Type
description: Base metadata fields embedded in every content file. YAML files use top-level fields. Markdown files use frontmatter.

instance.description: Instance name — must match a key in moui.json shapes

version.description: Shape version at time of creation

schema.description: Schema file name — must resolve to content/schema/

theme.description: Relative path from this file to the theme directory (e.g. 'themes/pitch')
